content.text:
I've submitted **index 11 (Co 0.29, V 0.71)** as the best composition. At 1.2 µA, it had the highest photocurrent of the three I measured.

All 3 merit measurements are used. I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase is inferred from composition only: this sample is close to CoV₂O₆, which sits at Co 0.33.

| Index | Co fraction | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0.54 | 0.03 µA |
| 11 | 0.29 | **1.2 µA** |
| 2 | 0.20 | 0.86 µA |

The Co-rich side performed poorly, and going more V-rich than index 11 lowered the photocurrent again. So the best region looks like roughly Co 0.25–0.33. Two samples in that region were never measured: index 9 (Co 0.24) and index 7 (Co 0.35). Either could beat index 11, and since the score only counts measured samples, that possible gain is lost.
